description: FormID change, compact renumber and reference update in a light Starfield plugin: Constellation.esm loaded as Sf33Light.esm (editable) has its records' FormIDs changed inside the file and renumbered from $800 (the compact form of a light module), with the reference information built, so the referencing record is edited too. The complex (small/light) FileIDs have to survive the change, the renumber and the injected-reference update.
